gen-audiowide-gf-noto-serif-sinhala: Futuristic and tile-like, Audiowide sets wide gaps between glyphs and makes every diagonal as stout as every upright. And Noto Serif Sinhala lets its weight ebb and flow gently, a soft voice under the loud machinery.
gen-audiowide-gf-suez-one: Tiled, techy letters: Audiowide draws every line like a rolling-ball pen, one width throughout. But Suez One, with its big open a and e, would carry paragraphs with a bookish, refined feel.
gen-black-ops-one-author: Black Ops One packs tight sidebearings and narrow c openings into letters that look cut from strips of equal width. Author adds calm weight shifts, made for brief spells of reading.
gen-black-ops-one-gf-hepta-slab: Tight, closed, commanding: Black Ops One looks drilled from solid stock, its c openings pinched narrow. Hepta Slab then lets words stretch out with open counters, so paragraphs feel bookish and unhurried.
gen-comfortaa-crimson-pro: Comfortaa draws every stroke like neon tube, never swelling or thinning, and its c is a wide ring. Crimson Pro brings a quiet, classic shift in line weight like brushed watercolor.
gen-comfortaa-gf-libertinus-serif: Neon-tube lines of constant weight define Comfortaa, with its spacing stretched out like an uncoiled spring. Libertinus Serif adds a soft, lightly pressed brush shift in weight, refined, authoritative.
gen-comfortaa-gf-libre-caslon-text: Comfortaa shows no thick-thin flicker at all, each stroke drawn like neon tube with loosely stretched spacing between letters. Libre Caslon Text brings editorial curves, slightly heavier than its joins.
gen-comfortaa-gf-maitree: Comfortaa traces each letter like a single thick thread, with a ring-shaped c and loosely stretched spacing. Maitree is a serif that steps softly from heavy to light strokes, dignified and classic.
gen-comfortaa-gf-marcellus: Round neon-tube strokes with no brush swell anywhere: that's Comfortaa. Against that constancy, Marcellus, a text serif, adds etched-glass thinning where curves meet stems, which is the pair's whole charm.
gen-comfortaa-gf-nanum-myeongjo: Thin steel rod bent into round, friendly letters: that's Comfortaa all over. Nanum Myeongjo, a text serif, carries paragraph after paragraph with soft contrast and curves whose tips never quite touch.
